mission_06: Vector spaces are sets closed under addition and scalar multiplication. The column space of a matrix is the span of its columns. The rank tells you the dimension of this space. A basis is a minimal set of vectors that spans the space — found via QR decomposition. Any vector can be projected onto a subspace, giving the closest point in that subspace. The residual (original minus projection) is orthogonal to the subspace. These concepts underpin least-squares regression, signal processing, and the geometry of high-dimensional data in machine learning.
